items.title: Nifty Approaches Resistance Near 26,200
items.summary: The Nifty index surged by 2.61% last week, adding 656 points on the back of robust foreign institutional investor inflows and positive technical patterns. Market participants are watching the 25,950 to 26,200 range as the next major hurdle for the ongoing bullish momentum. Meanwhile, banking, IT, and financial services sectors are taking the lead in driving these gains.
items.why: Tracking benchmark index resistance levels helps investors understand where profit-booking or breakout trading opportunities may emerge.

items.title: Gold Prices Extend Losses Amid Fed Hike Worries
items.summary: Gold prices recorded their steepest weekly decline since March, falling for the fifth consecutive trading session. The metal dropped to a 14-month low, with domestic multi-commodity exchange rates settling around Rs 1,21,949 per 10 grams and international spot prices touching $3,539 per ounce. Investors moved away from the yellow metal due to rising expectations of a US Federal Reserve rate hike, a stronger US dollar, and broader selling in artificial intelligence equities.
items.why: Precious metals often react inversely to interest rate hikes and dollar strength, as higher yields reduce the appeal of non-yielding assets like gold.

items.title: Infrastructure Investment Trust IPOs Target Rs 17,000 Crore
items.summary: The public offering pipeline for Infrastructure Investment Trusts is gaining momentum, with four to five private trusts preparing to launch initial public offerings by March 2027. These issuances aim to mobilize approximately Rs 17,000 crore in total capital. The funds raised will be channeled into building long-term capital for large-scale infrastructure projects across the country.
items.why: InvITs provide retail and institutional investors a structured way to earn yields from operational infrastructure assets while helping developers recycle capital.

items.title: Indian Rupee Climbs Past 93 Against US Dollar
items.summary: The Indian rupee strengthened past the 93 mark against the US dollar, trading around 92.67. This appreciation was largely driven by investors seeking shelter in Indian equities and market participants unwinding short positions on the local currency. Analysts note that while a stronger currency signals domestic economic resilience, it can introduce headwinds for export-heavy sectors like information technology.
items.why: Currency fluctuations impact import costs, foreign institutional investments, and the profitability of companies that earn revenue in foreign currencies.

items.title: Wall Street Correction Deepens on Tech Sell-Off
items.summary: US equity benchmarks experienced a severe weekly sell-off, pushing both the S&P 500 and the Dow Jones Industrial Average into official correction territory. The Nasdaq also turned negative for the year as aggressive liquidations hit technology and growth counters. Major financial institutions warn that systematic investors and algorithmic funds could trigger additional waves of selling if key support levels fail to hold.
items.why: Global markets are deeply interconnected, and steep corrections on Wall Street frequently influence sentiment and institutional fund flows in emerging markets like India.

items.title: Anthropic Stumble Highlights Stretched AI Valuations
items.summary: Artificial intelligence firm Anthropic experienced a post-debut stumble, with its shares falling roughly 9% from initial levels. This sluggish market performance delivered a reality check to investors who had high hopes for marquee tech listings. Market observers noted that the weak debut deepened existing concerns regarding overextended valuations across the broader artificial intelligence sector.
items.why: High-profile technology IPOs serve as barometers for risk appetite and valuation sanity in emerging growth sectors.

items.title: Brickwork Ratings Projects India GDP Growth at 7 Percent
items.summary: Rating agency Brickwork Ratings has projected India's gross domestic product growth at 7 percent for the financial year 2027. The economic outlook report also anticipates a potential 25 basis point interest rate hike by central monetary authorities during upcoming policy reviews to manage liquidity and inflationary pressures. Government officials continue to highlight India's strong relative growth rate compared to other major global economies.
items.why: GDP growth forecasts and central bank rate decisions dictate the macro environment for corporate earnings and consumer borrowing costs.

items.title: SP Apparels Announces 1:5 Stock Split
items.summary: SP Apparels has received approval for a 1:5 stock split, dividing each existing equity share with a face value of Rs 10 into five shares with a face value of Rs 2. The corporate action is designed to adjust the share price without altering the overall value of an investor's holding. December 10 has been fixed as the official record date to determine eligible shareholders.
items.why: Stock splits increase the number of circulating shares and lower the per-share price, which can improve trading liquidity for retail participants.
